meta.title: Splatoon Raiders – Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive - Nintendo Official Site for Canada
meta.description: Splat enemies and hunt treasure in Splatoon Raiders, a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. Customize gear, build gadgets, and raid the mysterious Spirhalite Islands.

modules.heading: Hunt for treasure in a wild adventure!

content.value: In this single-player-focused game, play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut—a trio of swashbuckling musicians—and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands!
Customize your character, kit yourself out with mechanical gadgets and ink-splattering weapons, and take on waves of enemy Salmonids as you raid the islands for treasure.

modules.heading: A series of images featuring Shiver, Frye, Big Man, Salmonids, bosses and the Mechanic scroll slowly across screen.

content.value: A strange storm forces a helicopter carrying Deep Cut to the Spirhalite Islands to make an emergency landing.
After a month of scraping together a hideout ship, you and your crew are ready to raid the nearby islands for the rumored treasure you came for—and find a way home!

Each tank is compatible with its own range of specialized gadgets, which you can further customize using the loot you find. Equip the one that matches your play style—or swap tanks between missions to try a different approach.

assets.alt: An Inkling faces off against two Salmonid bosses. As enemy yellow ink spalts across the screen, the Inkling counters with purple ink from their speed tank

content.value: Compatible with gadgets that boost your mobility. They can’t hurt you if they can’t hit you!

assets.alt: An Inkling unleashes a powerful green ink splat toward a Salmonid from their Power Tank. Power Eggs fly towards them along with the total hit points from the shot.

content.value: Feel like tackling the swarms of Salmonids head-on? This tank is for you, boss!

assets.alt: A pink-haired Inkling runs alongside their Tactial tank that shoots pink ink towards a nearby enemy.

content.value: Perfect for the thinking Inkling, this tank employs gadgets that let you control the battlefield
your
way.

modules.heading: A video showing an Inkling searching for treaure. It cuts into an Inkling and Bot Buddy facing off against multiple Salmonids and collecting Power Eggs.
A green-haired Inkling prepares to face off against a Salmonid. As green ink swirls around them, they unleash a powerful splat and toward the oncoming attack.
A pink-haired Inkling releases their Tactical tank and unleashes pink ink toward an oncoming enemy.

content.value: This mysterious cluster of islands has a surprisingly diverse environment, both above and below ground. Go see what’s what!
Pick a destination and see what goodies you can find. Fight Salmonids, gather salvage, and uncover the mysteries of the islands.

assets.alt: A Raid map shows Puos Island, Tumetto Rocks along with the Salmonoid level and the chance to find treaure.

content.value: Scoop up purdy Spirhalite Crystals and other salvage that you find out there—you never know what might come in handy! Some stages may also contain rare relics that can power you up. You’ll keep everything you pick up on solo raids, no matter what happens.

assets.alt: A golden, scalloped treasure chest glows as it opens to reveal the treasure inside.

content.value: Not gonna lie: Salmonids can put up a fight. Use the salvage you recover during raids to craft all sorts of enhancements back at your Hideout Ship. Whether you’re upgrading gear, leveling up weapons, or enhancing home base, every little bit helps!

assets.alt: A green-haired Inkling hunkers over an ink tank as a text box appears beside them asking them to construct a new gadget.

modules.heading: Video featuring an Inkling with blue hair charges forward on a beach. We quickly cut to a pink-haired Inkling splatting down a Salmonid, before showcasing the location of the Raid on the map.
Video showing an Inkling machine drilling into a a blue crystal-like rock reveals hidden treasure. The video then cuts to the treasure chest opening to showcase the Two-fisted Salmonid statue.
An Inkling tinkers with one of their gadgets adding in Sphiralite shards. We then cut to seeing an inlking testing their new gadget out in a showstopper move.

content.value: Just, uh, you know, stay out of the water, ‘kay?

assets.alt: An Inkling runs across a freshly splashed bed of teal ink.

content.value: Splash the stuff all over the place using your weapons. It’s offense, it’s defense, it’s transportation—make good use of it!

assets.alt: An Inkling dives into the teal ink in their squid form.

content.value: Change into Swim Form to move quickly through your own ink color (and refill your tank). You can swim up ink-covered walls, through certain barriers, and more.

assets.alt: An Inkling soars up into the air above the sea.

content.value: Move into a gust of wind to soar across gaps or gain height. Handy for exploring—or getting a better angle on your enemies!

modules.heading: A teal-haired Inkling splats mulitple bursts of ink creating a perfect pool of ink across the sand.
A teal-haired Inkling changes into their Squid-like Swim Form, dives into their freshly splatted ink and swims around.
An Inkling is launched into the air and falls gracefully through rings, collecting Spirahlite Shards as they descend.

asset.alt: Shiver is seen inside their Bot Buddy as it gently pulsates up and down on the screen.

modules.heading: Roll out with your bot buddy

content.value: One member of Deep Cut will raid alongside you in a powerful bot construct. Aside from helping in battle, you can jump off them to soar to new heights or build up powerful Showstopper attacks. Wield them wisely to unleash absolute heck!

assets.alt: An Inkling faces towards their Bot Buddy as it drills down into the ground.

modules.heading: A teal-haired Inkling calls out to their Bot Buddy which then appears and begins to drill into the ground.

content.value: Get to know your treasure-hunting crew.

asset.alt: A teal-haired Inkling wearing orange pants holds a gadget as they look up towards a potential enemy.

content.value: This is you! Your fix-it skills seem to know no bounds, which is great for upcycling all that salvage you find. Plus, you can choose your own look!

asset.alt: Your ally Shiver stands posed with a fan, ready to attack.

content.value: Cool, calculated, and relatively collected, she descends from a long line of shark tamers.

asset.alt: Another ally, Frye is seen mid movement as they raise their hand towards the right of the screen.

content.value: This feisty eel charmer wears her emotions on her sleeve. Sometimes, those emotions look a lot like fists.

asset.alt: A Manta-ray looking ally, Big Man stretches out their fins and smiles towards you.

content.value: Ay. Ay! (The loveable heart of the group. As head of the Manta Clan dance school, he knows a thing or two about busting a move!)

Fight off hordes of Salmonid enemies that seem a little more vicious than usual, including some never-before-seen forms. On the flipside, the loot they drop can make your life easier in the long run. Salmonid numbers can get out of hand quickly, so watch your back!

modules.heading: A large collection featuring multiple types of Salmoids players can expect to face off against.

content.value: Tap in a Splatoon series amiibo™ figure*** (like these) to unlock stylish fits for the Mechanic.

modules.heading: Want to learn waaay more about the world of Splatoon?

content.value: Splatoon Raiders can meet you where you’re at!
Find your sweet spot with Tourist, Raider, and Survivalist difficulty levels. Change it anytime! Just know that this only affects combat, not the loot you can get.

assets.alt: A screen showcasing the various difficulty modes of the game. The Squid cursor hovers beside the middle difficulty of "Raider". Also featured are the Tourist and Survivalist difficulty levels.

content.value: You can also join with up to three other players online* or via local wireless**. Call ‘em in if you need help with a stage (or just want to splat Salmonids with a friend). The game will scale player power automatically to help make sure everyone has a good time.

assets.alt: Frye and Big Man pose together on the docks.

modules.heading: A screen showcasing the various difficulty modes of the game. The Squid cursor moves between Tourist, Raide and Survivalist.
Big Man, Shivver and Frye stand on the docks interacting with each other and the Mechanic character.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100122824\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut—a trio of swashbuckling musicians—and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands! Customize your character’s look, kit yourself out with gadgets and ink-splattering weapons, and take on waves of foes called Salmonids as you raid the islands for salvage. Then use that salvage to craft and upgrade your gear for the next raid!

This is mainly a single-player adventure, but you won’t be alone. One member of Deep Cut will raid alongside you in a powerful bot—it can launch you to new heights and build up powerful Showstopper attacks to unleash absolute heck upon your foes. You can also join with up to three other players online* or via local wireless**.

Choose a tank and gadgets that suit your splatting style

Equip one of three tanks, each compatible with its own range of specialized gadgets. Pick the one that matches your play style, or even swap tanks between missions to try a different approach.

Feel like tackling the swarms of Salmonids head-on? The Power Tank’s gadgets will have you smashing through crowds with brute force. If finesse is more your thing, try the Speed Tank and its assortment of mobility gadgets—they can’t hurt you if they can’t hit you! Of course, the thinking Inklings out there will want to check out the Tactical Tank, which sports gadgets to control the battlefield.

You can further customize your tanks and gadgets using the loot you find!

Dial in your difficulty

Find your sweet spot with three difficulty levels. You can change the difficulty anytime—it only affects enemy strength, and does not change the loot you get on raids.

Tap any Splatoon series amiibo figure for an in-game outfit

Get an in-game outfit by tapping any compatible Splatoon series amiibo™ figure***. You can also get other exclusive in-game outfits by tapping the Shiver, Frye, and Big Man Splatoon Raiders amiibo figures!
